laws.rule: Lofoten: the six Lofoten municipalities have outdoor regulations, drawn up with the Lofoten outdoor council (Lofoten Friluftsråd) and Destination Lofoten, and a tourist map shows where tents and campervans are not allowed. The tourism page lists these wild-camping conditions: at least 150 metres from any building; not on private land or farmland; no driving off the road; no parking in passing places on narrow roads; obey signs banning parking, camping or overnight stays for motorhomes and caravans; keep four metres from other vehicles; take rubbish out and empty toilets only at emptying stations. It asks visitors not to pitch tents on top of Reinebringen. The page names no penalties. Which municipality bans what was not listed there, so check the map and each municipality.
